reference_images.note: The Reflection and effects references produced by the amd64 image under emulation were byte-identical to the arm64 output; the semantics-hir workflow regenerates them natively on x86-64.

reference_commands: docker run --rm --network none -v OUT/corpus:/corpus:ro -v tests/semantics/w11-hir:/w:ro IMAGE php -n /w/compile_dump.php /corpus > OUT/compile-reference.jsonl
docker run --rm --network none -v tests/semantics/w11-hir:/w:ro IMAGE php -n /w/reflect.php /w/reflect/NAME.php > tests/semantics/w11-hir/reflect/NAME.json
docker run --rm --network none -v tests/semantics/w11-hir:/w:ro IMAGE php -n /w/effects.php /w/effects/NAME.php > tests/semantics/w11-hir/effects/NAME.json

result.corpus_files_skipped: 142 files the front end or PHP rejects as syntax errors
result.reflection_fixtures: 3 of 3 identical (functions, methods, closures, parameters, types, statics, captures, compile-time values)
result.fuzz: about 11.7 million executions in 60 seconds, no failure

limitations: Only PHP 8.5.12; the corpus comparison ran with the 64-bit profile.
Object-model, attribute and built-in function compile checks are not raised yet; their count is pinned by internal/ir/corpus_gaps_test.go.
Effects are compared for soundness against observed behaviour, not for precision; callback counts at run time need the VM (W-17, W-39).
